title: the timezone parse consumed the string terminator and read the byte after it
consumer: wsutil/ws_strptime.c, the timezone case of the format walk
object: the timezone string, one direct allocation holding just its terminator
lifetime_ender: NONE -- the buffer is alive throughout. SPATIAL row.
shape: a character scan with no case for the terminator, which steps past it
allocator_layer: the platform allocator itself: one direct allocation, no inner layer. wsutil does not use wmem.
fidelity: model consumer, real control flow: the missing switch arm is upstream's.
live_proof: absent at the pin: v4.6.8:wsutil/ws_strptime.c carries the `case '\0':` arm that stops the scan at the terminator (`grep -c` = 1). It is absent at c556b648aa^. A fix-reversal.

native-fix-differential.oracle: the buggy arm's read crosses the allocation and the case's damage flag is set; the fixed arm's bound keeps it inside. The arms differ by the upstream fix, not by protection. ASan reports heap-buffer-overflow at the labelled probe on the buggy arm and is silent on the fixed arm -- keyed on heap-buffer-overflow, never on the string AddressSanitizer.

cheribsd-revocation.target: stock CheriBSD purecap with libc revocation on
cheribsd-revocation.oracle: MEASURED 2026-10-08, results/2026-10-08-cheribsd/: **NOT CAUGHT, and clean here is NOT a negative result about the defect.** The sequence COMPLETES, exit status 0, with supervise resolving `expect wsh_read_probe 0x10237a` from the ELF -- so the probe was found and simply never faulted. THE MECHANISM: malloc bounds a capability to the allocator's USABLE size and not to the request, so a crossing shorter than the gap to the next size class stays inside the same allocation and no capability check can see it. This is a property of the allocator's granularity, not of the bug. tools/size-class-audit.py reports this case ABSORBED from the request size measured on the x86-64 host build (no element of this allocation is a pointer, so the purecap request is the same), and the two agree. The Capstone arms are the discriminating ones here.
cheribsd-revocation.platform: stock CheriBSD purecap, kernel CHERI-PURECAP-QEMU, revocation ON (--runtime-revocation on); both platform controls cheribsd-abi and cheribsd-bounds PASSED in the same boot.
